description: United States Navy transport that force-landed on the black sand of Sólheimasandur on 21 November 1973. The fuselage has been deliberately retained in place by the landowners and is presented to visitors with a paid car park and a shuttle service. Originally built as an R4D-5 and converted to R4D-8 configuration in November 1951.

Former Flugfélag Íslands airliner that flew Icelandic domestic routes from 1951 and was the last DC-3 in regular Icelandic passenger service. Last flown in 1976. Bought by the Sólheimasandur landowners and placed on the sand as a second display aircraft in June 2025. More complete than the older wreck with engines and cockpit in place.
